### TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions Appoints Sue Schick as Chief Executive Officer

_Founder Eric Pezzi to transition to the Board of Directors as company enters next phase of growth in specialty condition management_

LAKE MARY, Fla. , Aug.
11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions, a physician-led specialty condition management company, today announced that Sue Schick has been appointed Chief Executive Officer effective August 3rd. Schick succeeds founder Eric Pezzi, who is retiring from the CEO role after leading the company since its founding in 2014. Pezzi will remain closely involved with TurningPoint as a member of the company's board of directors.

Continue Reading

Sue Schick

"Leading TurningPoint from an idea to a company serving more than 45 million lives has been the privilege of my career. Our team's unwavering belief that clinical expertise should drive every decision, that safety, quality, and affordability shouldn't be treated as competing priorities, and that technology should be the glue that lets clinicians scale their expertise, is what has made this company successful. I have complete confidence in Sue and in every person across this organization to carry that forward.

# TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions names Sue Schick CEO as founder transitions to board chair

● 5 days ago

TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions has appointed Sue Schick as chief executive officer. Schick succeeds founder Eric Pezzi, who is retiring from the role after leading the company since 2014. Pezzi will remain on the board of directors.
Schick brings over 30 years of healthcare industry experience. She most recently served as president and chief revenue officer at Zelis. She previously held senior roles at Humana and UnitedHealth Group.
TurningPoint is a physician-led speciality condition management company focusing on musculoskeletal and cardiovascular care. The company supports more than 45 million covered lives nationwide and manages over $4 billion in healthcare costs annually.
The company was founded in 2014 and operates across all 50 states.
